commentary_title: Rates improve on higher loading in the US
commentary_summary: VLGC spot rates improving with easing congestion at US Gulf; backlog created due to hurricane delays clearing. | Limited activity in the East of Suez but fixtures look to increase on Indian demand ahead of festivals. | No major impact on LPG shipping so far due to the escalating Iran- Israel tensions in the Middle East. | A longer fixing window and narrowing US-Asia arbitrage expected to curb the rise in VLGC rates. | LPG demand in the Asian petchem sector expected to decline due to negative margins and competition from naphtha.
